[list]──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
[b]URGENT: The entire country of Pirn is in civil war.
[sub]URGENT : Le pays de Pirn tout entier est en proie à la guerre civile.[/b][/sub]
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────[/list]

[i][b]P I R N ─[/b][/i] The [b]Union Government of Pirn[/b] has declared a [i][b]Level 1 Federal Emergency[/b][/i], the highest alert classification in the country, after large parts of northern [b]Reine[/b] on [i]Épiroux Island[/i], eastern [b]Baria[/b], and southern [b]Rupert[/b] on [i]Lisdoran Island[/i] descended into chaos. The unrest erupted when an insurgent faction calling itself the [b]Second Pirn Republic[/b] or the [b]Republic Restoration Front[/b] launched an armed uprising in response to sweeping reforms passed by the Pirn Parliament.

The reform package, officially titled the [i][b]Comprehensive Reform and Overhaul of Government, Law, and Constitution[/b][/i], widely referred to as the [i][b]Pirn Libre Resolution[/b][/i], transforms Pirn from a [i]unitary parliamentary republic[/i] into a [i]unitary parliamentary republic with a Union-style administrative structure[/i]. Under the new arrangement, regional governments gain limited autonomy while remaining under the strong influence of the Union Government, the newly established central authority. The reforms were intended to address longstanding demands from both human and furry communities for greater regional representation. However, hardline nationalist groups within both communities decried the changes, claiming the new system would deepen divisions rather than promote unity.

On June 19, one day after the reform package passed, dissidents announced the formation of the [b]Republic Restoration Front[/b], commonly known as the [b]Second Republic[/b], with the stated goal of dismantling the Union system, restoring the previous fully unitary parliamentary model, and ultimately establishing a new republic. The faction has since launched armed resistance across the affected provinces, overwhelming local police forces and prompting the deployment of the [b]Pirn Defence Force (PDF)[/b].

At the Prime Ministers Office, Prime Minister [b]Monica Franklin[/b] delivered a fiery address, vowing to crush the uprising and restore order as swiftly as possible: [i]We must cut this tumor out of Mother Pirn, or she will die from it.[/i]

President [b]Ariana Doolan[/b], in contrast, issued a calmer but still firm appeal:
▌[i]I urge the insurgents to cease what they call a Revolution. They are far too quick to assume this new government will divide our people. A flower does not bloom overnight; we must give this new system time to grow. I also call on the Prime Minister and the Defence Force to avoid inflicting excessive harm on either side, especially civilians. I ask the leaders of the Republican Front to show restraint and work with the Union Government to find a path toward leniency. And I call on our regional governors and citizens to stand united. We have suffered enough through the Sudbury War, will we now turn our weapons on our own brothers and sisters? Would Thomas Lavery, father of our nation, approve of those who invoke Revolution to topple the state he and generations before him built? Would Mother Pirn smile upon land soaked in the blood of her own children who kill one another believing they are doing her good?[/i]

President Doolans remarks sparked a wave of public support. Several regional governors immediately pledged unconditional loyalty to the Union Government, and citizens in unaffected regions poured into the streets, demonstrating solidarity between both human and furry populations.

But in the conflict zones, reactions were sharply different. Some civilians and local officials openly voiced support for restoring the old republic and declared they were prepared to use any means necessary, including threats against civilians, to pressure the Union Government into conceding. Emergency evacuations have been ordered across affected areas of Baria, Reine, and Rupert, effectively dividing Pirn into two opposing camps: the [b]Loyalist Regions,[/b] collectively referred to as [i]the Union[/i], and the [b]Republican Front,[/b] commonly known as [i]the Rebels[/i].

Clashes continue across multiple fronts, and casualties have already been reported on both sides.

[*][sub]The [i]Orion Children's Hospital[/i] in [i]Baria[/i] was attacked by rebels, sparking a wave of fierce protests across Pirn.[/sub]
[*][sub]One of the rebel leaders, [i]Casey Richardson[/i], has just been captured, becoming the first leader in the conflict to be arrested.[/sub][/list]

In this history, he wears a black sleeveless coat with dark blue shorts and a pair black boots, in his arms he wears orange elbow pads.
he once tried eating the same musijang with his own brother, they found it and decided to eat at the same time, but it ended that he got the power when he was 10 years old since he swallowed it first than his younger brother, and ended with the full control of flames powers.
....
Now, 2027,  7 years later, Han Jiwon left to the seas, with the help of his family he managed to build a skiff named [b]Tadak-Tadak[/b].
It has a V shaped, made of metal with aluminum and ceramic, the user always is standing in the middle with one of his legs in a funnel chamber of ceramic below to where the user stands, as the user generates the flames, the fire travels to the boat back and then due to the inner shape of the chamber, the fire goes compressed into a fire propulsion, the funnel chamber acts as the rudder, as it relies on the user movement to direct the vessel. This means, if Han Jiwon moves his leg to the left, the skiff moves to the left, if he goes to the right, it goes to the right, it has a drain inside the chamber where if water falls inside it goes right back into the sea , the user may  control the speed depending on the pressure he makes on the funnel which also has a pressure plate inside with a shoe which is sealed as the user put his foot inside and it is immune to water, the user may remove it if he takes off his foot as well, the more pressure the user makes the faster it goes, the lesser the pressure, the slower it moves, the "deck" also is very usable for sitting down, so the user can decide either to stand or sit.
...
[i]Bye mom, and baby brother-eu![/i]
Jiwon standing on the deck of the skiff, extended his hand and waved as his skiff was on the waters , with a large smile that could shine with the sun hitting it, his brother, Han Yang-min, 14 years old, would pinch his own nose and then wave back.
[i]You surely will make your dream become true I know it[/I]
He would smile with confidence to his brother, before finally noticing what Jiwon meant, and "corrected":
[i]H-HEY wait I'm no baby brother,I'm already a teenager brother! [/i]
In response Jiwon simply laughed.
[i]AHAHAHAHAHA you can make yourself as angry as you wish, but you know you really aren't, just wait some years and you can go to the sea too, baby brother.[/i]
His mother, Park O-Na'ara, would simply roll her eyes, and clean with a tissue, containing any emotion from a large strong woman he was, to try not seem too emotional.
[i]Best of luck out there son, or whatever.[/i]
The other relatives of his, cousins, and uncles, would wave back, some in tears.
[i]He's still waving! Wave it back![/i]
[i]Good luck Jiwon!![/i]
[i]The seas protect you![/i]
The boy in the skiff would close his fist towards hos family, and in a confident tone would nod , appreciating their support and announced:
[i]Fine! Now I'm moving to the sea and going make a name for myself! My name will reach the pinnacle of the world![/i]

As he pressured more the  pressure plate in the funnel the more fire would appear on the skiff's back with the orange flames sound cracking behind.
He took a short break as the waves were relatively calm, to eat some noodles he had prepared into his backpack.
[i]Eh, what is that thing??[/i]
The flames man said as he arched an eyebrow seeing a fast moving black dot on the water, to large to be , he wasted no time trying to decipher what it was, instead he prepared the flames into his arm and defied the thing moving fast.
[b]SPLASH[/b]!!
it was a seal moving, the large animal jumped into the skiff trying to attack the badajuinim , he decided to attack, naturally, and extended his hand with open palm in front and said:
[i]POK-GYEOK(Fire explosion]!!
The fire in his hands moved towards the jumping animal in a flames wave which hit the belly of the seal, which after this was sent flying back into the water.
[i]You better let me eat next name your fatt-eu fishu![/i]
....
...

An old man fishing saw the scene, and got scared, but didn't escaped, Jiwon saw he scared the old man and inclined in an apology gesture:

Jiwon laughed, jumping from the skiff onto the sand.

He moved away from the pile of fish, examining it with the excitement of someone who has just received a mission. The old man remembered from afar, still a little wary of the boy who arrived in a boat on fire.

[i]Banditburi![/i](fireflies)
The particles infiltrated inside the grills metal sheet and started heating it, the ember light made the sheet to shine. The old man gaping his mouth observed.
[i]This is amazing, boy![/i]

[i]Yes! It is, my family used to teach me that fire could be well used to cook and to pretty much everything, not just combatu or defence.[/i]

Jiwon laughed, and took a bite of a sardine.
[i]Well thanks I guess sir and...uh...[/i]
He suddenly fallen asleep while eating, but his hand still holding tight the fish.
[i]What a hell happened to you?[/i]
[i]Zzzzz....[/i]
[i]...Narcoleptic?[/i]
Then, as suddenly as he fallen asleep, after manu minutes of silence , Jiwon awake;
[i]Oh, what happened?[/i]
[i]You fallen asleep.[/i]
[i]I didn't.[/i]

[i]Hmph...I'll agree but I'm still not believing this.[/i][/spoiler]
